name: Kumi
source:
A young female investigator.

She and her partner, Miho, accepted a job from a client after a period of poor business. The mission was to investigate the disappearance of women at a mansion.

Kumi was tasked with infiltrating the premises, disguised as a maid.

From "Double Impact" story.
